findings.claim: plugin/skills/write-docs/evals/iteration-1-benchmark.md is an empty aggregate (model "<model-name>", "3 runs each", 0% pass rate, 0 tokens) that contradicts results.md's 4/4 with and without the skill; a reviewer reading it sees a skill that failed every run.

The scripted checks that produced iteration 1's 4/4 (type folder, index entry, kmctl check, no stray page) live only in a session scratchpad grade.py; evals.json holds prompts and prose expected_output but no expectations, so the grading cannot be rerun from what is kept beside the skill.

verdict.text: The skill does what the plan asks: it routes by reader intent to one of four types, creates pages only through `kmctl new doc`, leaves the folder, skeleton and index to kmctl, and ends with `kmctl check`.
Every verb and option it names exists.
Two non-blocking defects sit in the eval artifacts kept beside the skill: a broken benchmark file and grading that is not kept.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format, tests and eval-row r1 pass; "stamp green: a47445b2347fd2d952c08e000b1dd9916771d3b02da94cfe79ea1cc936ca34c1".
r1: tests/test_skills.py::test_write_docs_skill_layout reads SKILL.md (fails if missing) and asserts each of the four reference files is a file, so it fails when the row's fails_when holds.

r2 (judgment): SKILL.md step 3 says to run `kmctl new doc TYPE 'Title' --description ...` and "Do not create the file, the folder or the index entry yourself"; step 4 fills only the skeleton's sections.
Nothing tells the agent to write front matter or an index entry.
Holds.
r3 (judgment): evals/evals.json holds four prompts, one per type; results.md records skill-creator iterations 1 and 2.
I opened the run workspaces: every with-skill and baseline page landed in its type folder (docs/tutorials, docs/how-to, docs/reference, docs/explanation), and each grading.json shows 4/4.
The iteration-2 tutorial takes the install command from the repo and leaves a TODO where no source exists, as results.md says.
Holds.
Verbs against the CLI: `kmctl new doc --help` (TYPE, TITLE, --description), `kmctl new decision|proposal|prototype|handoff`, `kmctl init`, `kmctl check` all exist.
The refusals step 3 maps (missing docs/README.md, page exists) match src/kmctl/docs.py.
Reference files agree with the skeleton sections in src/kmctl/docs.py and with .claude/rules/docs-layout.md's type definitions.
f1: iteration-1-benchmark.md is the skill-creator aggregate run that found no grading data, so it shows placeholders and zeros.
It contradicts results.md.
Non-blocking: delete it or regenerate it with real data; either plain fix is safe.
f2: ADR 0007 says to keep the test prompts so a reviewer can check them; the prompts are kept, but the four scripted checks behind "4/4" are not.
Add them as `expectations` in evals.json (or keep grade.py beside the skill).
Non-blocking: it strengthens evidence and changes no behavior.
Step 1 lists `kmctl new decision|proposal|prototype|handoff` and leaves out `practice`; that is a routing choice, not a defect.
